exact_missing_items: Execution-policy settings must allow the user to choose between fresh and retained-context retry workers; these must be separately configurable settings
Worker kind (subagent vs full agent) and retry-context policy (fresh vs retained) are SEPARATE settings — they must not be combined into a single toggle
Overseer-spawned node worker is the NORMAL/DEFAULT execution path, not an edge case — documentation must reflect this as the primary worker model
Node personas must be auto-selected from node scope/type; persona override must be a global node-worker policy setting, NOT a per-node override

Governance model must define 4 execution scopes: run = full canonical graph under deterministic runtime; work package = coherent precomputed subgraph with local overseer; feature seam = cross-package oversight scope; node = smallest executable unit

Each entity type must have its own lifecycle model — there is no single universal status enum: node lifecycle, work package lifecycle, feature seam lifecycle, promotion lifecycle, worktree lane lifecycle are all distinct

Three canonical promotion classes must be defined: lane_to_package (lane result → package baseline), package_to_seam_available (package → trusted seam contribution), seam_complete (seam marked complete)
Package completion is necessary but NOT sufficient for seam completion — integration quality at the seam level is a separate gate
Seam review loop must trigger at: package-completion boundaries, integration-edge/cross-package boundary crossings, before seam completion, and when package overseer raises a high-impact challenge
gap_candidates.blocking_reason: Coverage row indicates incomplete or missing canon alignment for concrete target.
